title: doing pre-viz using seedance and a blender fork has never been easier
author: Pradyumgg
selftext:
We wired Seedance 2.5 into Mixar, and now you can give your clay render as an input for your video.   
  
Quick context about Mixar, it is an AI Native 3D editor (Blender Fork), with native inference for image gen, model gen, video gen and even world gen (gaussian splats). And all of this can be driven by our agent which performs better than any MCP since it has your scene state info.

You get full camera control, push in, orbit, track, whatever the shot needs, and you go from blockout to finished render without leaving the editor.

Clip attached is straight out of it. Happy to answer questions on how the scene data gets passed through.

comments.author: monsterfurby
comments.body:
Not a mod and definitely not in a position to police this, but since I keep complaining on these posts, I would like to point out that, in my understanding, commercial products that aren't games are not allowed to be advertised here (mods correct me if I'm wrong).

But to add an actual discussion: what *is* the process for clay render based animation as video source anyway? I'd be interested in any experience with it.
